targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS time, server_handle AS metric, ((metrics->>'ram_total_bytes')::numeric - (metrics->>'ram_used_bytes')::numeric) / 1024 / 1024 AS value FROM server_metrics_history WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND ('$server' = 'All' OR server_handle IN (${server:sqlstring})) ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT recorded_at AS time, server_handle AS metric, ((metrics->>'disk_total_bytes')::numeric - (metrics->>'disk_used_bytes')::numeric) / 1024 / 1024 AS value FROM server_metrics_history WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND ('$server' = 'All' OR server_handle IN (${server:sqlstring})) ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT recorded_at AS time, server_handle || ' cpu' AS metric, (metrics->>'cpu_usage_pct')::numeric AS value FROM server_metrics_history WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND ('$server' = 'All' OR server_handle IN (${server:sqlstring})) UNION ALL SELECT recorded_at AS time, server_handle || ' load-1m' AS metric, (metrics->>'load_avg_1m')::numeric AS value FROM server_metrics_history WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND ('$server' = 'All' OR server_handle IN (${server:sqlstring})) ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT recorded_at AS time, server_handle AS metric, json_array_length(COALESCE(metrics->'containers', '[]'::json)) AS value FROM server_metrics_history WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND ('$server' = 'All' OR server_handle IN (${server:sqlstring})) ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT server_handle AS metric, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(recorded_at)) AS value FROM server_metrics_history WHERE ('$server' = 'All' OR server_handle IN (${server:sqlstring})) GROUP BY server_handle ORDER BY server_handle

list.name: server
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT server_handle FROM server_metrics_history WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) ORDER BY 1
